meta.description: Canonical source bibliography. Every citable document referenced in fact sheets, case files, or research notes.
meta.schema: sourceId → {citation, archive, url, corpusStatus, mediaPath, validationPath, notes}

dg-rec-pt1.citation: Gurney, Daniel. The Record of the House of Gournay, Part I. London: Priv. print. by J. B. Nichols and J. G. Nichols, 1848.
dg-rec-pt1.notes: Norman origins through Gerard de Gournay (G32). OCR quirks: Wilham/William (~6%), Basiha/Basilia (~16%). Page markers: ## p. N (#M) ## where N=book page.

dg-rec-pt2.citation: Gurney, Daniel. The Record of the House of Gournay, Part II. London: Priv. print. by J. B. Nichols and J. G. Nichols, 1848.
dg-rec-pt2.notes: Junior Norfolk Branch, West Barsham medieval Gurneys, through Henry G15.

dg-rec-pt3.citation: Gurney, Daniel. The Record of the House of Gournay, Part III. London: Priv. print. by J. B. Nichols and J. G. Nichols, 1848.
dg-rec-pt3.notes: Gurneys of Keswick: Francis G14 Merchant Taylor, Francis of Maldon, John of Norwich. Includes Appendix C (Court of Wards records, Merchant Taylors' Company membership).

dg-rec-supp.citation: Gurney, Daniel. The Record of the House of Gournay, Supplement. London: Priv. print., 1858.
dg-rec-supp.notes: Text extraction into corpus pending. Contains detailed notes supplementing all three parts.

nro-pd-12-1.shortTitle: NRO PD 12/1 (St Martin at Palace, Norwich)
nro-pd-12-1.citation: Parish register, St Martin at Palace, Norwich, 1538–1639. Norfolk Record Office, PD 12/1.
nro-pd-12-1.notes: BREAKTHROUGH SOURCE (March 2026): Francis Gurney + Margaret Rybett marriage, 23 September 1611. Image examined on Ancestry; paleographic reading confirmed.

nro-pd-86-41.citation: Parish register, East Dereham, Norfolk. Norfolk Record Office, PD 86/41 (microfilm, 69 images).
nro-pd-86-41.notes: Systematically reviewed. Five Francis Gurney baptisms identified (Entries A–E). Entry E: 'John son of [ffrancis Gurnie?]' — four-test paleographic analysis supports ffrancis over Nicholas. Margaret Rybett death revised to c.1616–17 based on 9-month impossibility test.

anderson-gmd-2015.citation: Anderson, Robert Charles. The Great Migration Directory: Immigrants to New England, 1620–1640: A Concise Compendium. Boston: NEHGS, 2015.
anderson-gmd-2015.notes: John Gurney-1 entry. Assigns 'Unknown' English origin = implicit rejection of Banks's Bury St. Edmunds attribution under modern standards. Arrival date: 1636 — discrepancy with June 1641 Weymouth record; unresolved.

banks-brownell-1937.citation: Banks, Charles Edward, and Elijah Ellsworth Brownell. Topographical Dictionary of 2885 English Emigrants to New England, 1620–1650. Philadelphia, 1937.
banks-brownell-1937.notes: East Anglian placement of John-1 weakens Candidate A (Stewkley) more than Candidate B.

blomefield-norfolk.citation: Blomefield, Francis. An Essay Towards a Topographical History of the County of Norfolk. 11 vols. London, 1805–1810.
blomefield-norfolk.notes: Key parish entries: Harpley (vol. viii, pp.452–459), West Barsham (vol. vii, pp.42–47), Great Ellingham (vol. ii). Independently confirms multiple DG pedigree points.

hop-gurney.citation: History of Parliament Trust. 'Sir John Gurney (d.1408).' The History of Parliament: the House of Commons. historyofparliamentonline.org.
hop-gurney.notes: Sir John Gurney d.1408 biography. Confirms collateral status: son Edmund died under age, estates to nephew Thomas (Robert's son). John of Gaunt stewardship to be verified here.

pease-pennyghael.citation: Pease, Howard. Gurney family genealogy. pennyghael.org.uk/Gurney.pdf.
pease-pennyghael.notes: Source of Ryvett claim for Francis G14's first wife. Confirmed against NRO PD 12/1 (March 2026).

burke-ancient-family.shortTitle: Burke, The Ancient Family of Gurney
burke-ancient-family.citation: Burke. 'The Ancient Family of Gurney.' TN298479 (project knowledge file).
burke-ancient-family.notes: Secondary source. Used for heraldic and general family context.

hingham-register.notes: Ann Gurney married John Gilman, 1 Oct 1626. Relationship to Francis G14's family unresolved.

brs-v21.citation: Buckinghamshire Record Society, vol. 21. 1642 Buckinghamshire tax records.

vch-bucks-v3.citation: Victoria County History: A History of the County of Buckingham, vol. 3.
vch-bucks-v3.notes: Stewkley manors. Used in Candidate A analysis.

freebmd-freereg.notes: FreeREG confirmed Francis G14 burial 9 Jan 1646/7, St Botolph Bishopsgate. Corrected Boyd's 1641 misread.

domesday-1086.notes: Hugh de Gournay III (G33): Liston, Fordham, Ardleigh (Essex); Norfolk properties. Referenced in DG-I.
